question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Dodge
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4 (Trick)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Dodge"** means to avoid something by a quick movement or clever manoeuvre. (बचाना)

 
 
• **Example: **He **dodged **the ball thrown at him by quickly stepping aside.
 
 
 
• **"Trick"** refers to a clever or deceitful action meant to achieve a goal or outwit someone. (चालाकी/चाल)
 
 
• **Example: **The magician performed an amazing **trick **that left the audience stunned.
 
 
 
• Hence, "Dodge" and "Trick" are synonymous as they both involve clever or skilful actions to avoid or deceive.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4 (Trick)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Panic** (घबराहट): A sudden overwhelming fear or anxiety that may cause irrational behaviour.

 
 
• **Example:** She felt **panic **when she realized she had lost her wallet.
 
 
 
• **Opine** (मत व्यक्त करना): To express an opinion about something.
 
 
• **Example:** He **opined **that the new policy would benefit small businesses.
 
 
 
• **Display** (प्रदर्शन): To show or exhibit something publicly.
 
 
• **Example:** The artist's paintings were **displayed **at the gallery last weekend.
